create.name: Viśrāma-ghāṭa
create.location: On the Yamunā in Mathurā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma rested here after killing Kaṁsa. The parikramā of Vraja begins and ends with a bath and a vow here; Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed here when He first came to Mathurā.

create.name: Śrī Kṛṣṇa Janma-sthāna
create.about: The place of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's birth in Kaṁsa's prison, where Vasudeva and Devakī saw Him with four arms; the deity of Keśava-deva is worshipped here.

create.name: Dhruva-ṭīlā
create.location: South Mathurā, by the Yamunā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where the boy Dhruva worshipped the Lord on Nārada's instruction; the Dhruva-tīrtha ghāṭa is below.

create.name: Raṅgeśvara Mahādeva
create.location: By the Raṅgabhūmi, Kaṁsa's wrestling arena (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Near the arena where Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma fought Cāṇūra and Muṣṭika and killed Kaṁsa; Śiva here is Raṅgeśvara, a protector (kṣetra-pāla) of Mathurā.

create.name: Bhūteśvara Mahādeva
create.about: Śiva as Bhūteśvara, one of the protectors of Mathurā; Pātāla-devī is nearby.

create.name: Mahāvidyā-devī
create.about: The temple of the goddess Mahāvidyā; Nanda Mahārāja and the gopas worshipped Ambikā-devī in this area.

create.name: Tālavana
create.location: About six miles south of Mathurā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma killed the ass-demon Dhenukāsura for the pleasure of the sakhās. Balabhadra-kuṇḍa and a temple of Baladeva are here.

create.name: Kumudavana
create.location: Two miles west of Tālavana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Now called Kudaravana. Kṛṣṇa, Balarāma and the cowherd boys played in Kumudinī-kuṇḍa (Vihāra-kuṇḍa) and decorated each other with kumudinī flowers while the cows drank.

create.name: Śantanu-kuṇḍa
create.location: On the way from Mathurā to Bahulāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Now called Satoha. King Śantanu performed austerities here; the temple of Śrī Śantanu-bihārījī is on its bank.

create.name: Bahulāvana
create.location: Seven miles west of Mathurā, between Rādhā-kuṇḍa and Vṛndāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Now called Bāṭī. Bahulā, Śrī Hari's sakhī, lives here; Saṅkarṣaṇa-kuṇḍa and Māna-sarovara are here. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell into ecstasy when He entered this forest.

create.name: Kusuma-sarovara
create.about: Where Śrī Rādhā and the sakhīs picked flowers and met Kṛṣṇa; Nārada-kuṇḍa and Ratna-siṁhāsana are nearby.

create.name: Mānasī-gaṅgā
create.about: The Gaṅgā manifested here from Kṛṣṇa's mind; here Kṛṣṇa, as a boatman, rowed Rādhikā across. On its banks are the temple of Śrī Harideva, Brahma-kuṇḍa and Mānasa-devī.

create.name: Cakleśvara (Cakra-tīrtha)
create.location: On the north side of Mānasī-gaṅgā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: When Indra flooded Vraja, Mahādeva raised his trident like a cakra to protect Giriraja and the Vrajavāsīs, and became Cakreśvara. In front of his temple is the bhajana-kuṭī of Sanātana Gosvāmī.

create.name: Dāna-ghāṭī
create.location: On the Govardhana parikramā path (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where Kṛṣṇa stopped the gopīs and demanded a tax (dāna) on their milk products; Dāna-nivartana-kuṇḍa is nearby.

create.name: Uddhava-kuṇḍa
create.about: Uddhava lives here as a creeper or grass, so that the dust of the gopīs' feet may fall on him.
